name: codetether-rust
description: Rust auto-imports, assists, live issues, navigation, checks and reviewed fixes.

commands.title: CodeTether Rust: Build & Publish Shared Cache
CodeTether Rust: Enable Check on Save

codetether.rust.navigation.enabled.description: Enable buffer-aware navigation and symbols using a dedicated rust-analyzer binary (no Cargo checks, build scripts or proc macros). Independent of the TUI diagnostics server.

codetether.rust.navigation.serverPath.description: rust-analyzer executable on the extension host, not a shell command. No automatic installation.

codetether.rust.navigation.autoImport.description: Include out-of-scope symbols in completion; accepting a suggestion inserts its use import. Does not add Cargo dependencies.

codetether.rust.navigation.diagnostics.description: Show live rust-analyzer syntax/semantic issues without running Cargo check. Uses a separate Problems collection; disable if a shared TUI feed reports duplicate issues.

codetether.rust.navigation.inlayHints.description: Offer inferred type, parameter and chaining inlay hints. Visibility also follows VS Code's editor.inlayHints.enabled setting.

codetether.rust.useSccache.description: Set RUSTC_WRAPPER to sccache and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 for Cargo subprocesses. Inherits host-side MinIO/S3 configuration and credentials. Does not restart daemons or cache ra-jit's in-memory compilation.

codetether.rust.sccacheExecutable.description: sccache executable on the extension host, not a shell command. Credentials belong in host-side configuration, never here.

codetether.rust.checkOnSave.description: Run ordinary Cargo check after saving Rust/Cargo files. Can execute build scripts. Use Enable Check on Save to avoid duplicate rust-analyzer checks.

codetether.rust.checkOnSaveDelay.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds; concurrent saves coalesce.

codetether.rust.sharedDiagnostics.description: Display workspace-matched diagnostics published by running native CodeTether LSP clients, including the TUI.

codetether.rust.diagnosticsDirectory.description: Override native diagnostics cache location on this host. Empty uses the CodeTether user cache.

codetether.rust.fixModel.description: Optional provider/model for tool-free repair proposals. Empty uses CodeTether's configured model.

codetether.rust.executable.description: CodeTether executable on the extension host, not a shell command.

codetether.rust.toolchain.description: Rustup toolchain; ra-jit operations require Rust 1.99.0.

codetether.rust.runArgs.description: Program arguments, passed literally without shell expansion.
